sentences.en: Mia found a wallet on the bus.
sentences.zh: 米雅在公車上撿到一個錢包。

sentences.en: Inside were some money and an ID card.
sentences.zh: 裡面有一些錢和一張身分證。

sentences.en: She was reluctant to keep it, so she decided to find the owner.
sentences.zh: 她不願意把它留下來，所以決定找到失主。

sentences.en: The card showed an address, but it was not accurate.
sentences.zh: 證件上有一個地址，但並不準確。

sentences.en: Mia did not abandon the plan and went to the police station.
sentences.zh: 米雅沒有放棄這個計畫，而是去了警察局。

sentences.en: An officer helped her call the owner.
sentences.zh: 一位警察幫她聯絡失主。

sentences.en: An hour later, a young man ran in, out of breath.
sentences.zh: 一小時後，一位年輕男子氣喘吁吁地跑進來。

sentences.en: He was grateful and thanked her again and again.
sentences.zh: 他非常感激，一再向她道謝。

sentences.en: Mia smiled and said that honesty brings its own benefit.
sentences.zh: 米雅微笑著說，誠實本身就會帶來好處。

sentences.en: Tom works for a small company in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 湯姆在台北一家小公司工作。

sentences.en: This morning, the manager announced a new project.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，經理宣布了一項新專案。

sentences.en: The goal was to eliminate waste and improve efficiency.
sentences.zh: 目標是消除浪費並提升效率。

sentences.en: Tom felt anxious because the schedule was tight.
sentences.zh: 湯姆感到焦慮，因為時程很緊。

sentences.en: The price of materials continued to fluctuate, so the budget was uncertain.
sentences.zh: 材料價格持續波動，所以預算並不確定。

sentences.en: His team shared ideas and made a clear plan.
sentences.zh: 他的團隊分享想法，擬定了一個清楚的計畫。

sentences.en: By evening, they had finished the first stage of the project.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，他們已經完成了專案的第一階段。

sentences.en: Tom realized that teamwork is the key to success.
sentences.zh: 湯姆體會到團隊合作是成功的關鍵。

title: A Summer Trip to the Sea

sentences.en: Last summer, Anna and her little brother traveled to a small island.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，安娜和她的弟弟去一座小島旅行。

sentences.en: They took an overnight train and then a ferry.
sentences.zh: 他們先搭夜車，再搭渡輪。

sentences.en: The sea was calm, and the sky was clear.
sentences.zh: 海面很平靜，天空很晴朗。

sentences.en: Near the rocks, they saw colorful fish in the water.
sentences.zh: 在岩石附近，他們看見水裡有五顏六色的魚。

sentences.en: Her little brother was nervous about swimming, but Anna encouraged him.
sentences.zh: 她的弟弟對游泳感到緊張，但安娜鼓勵他。

sentences.en: In the evening, they watched a splendid sunset together.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，他們一起欣賞了壯麗的夕陽。

sentences.en: Anna said that she would never forget that peaceful day.
sentences.zh: 安娜說她永遠不會忘記那個平靜的日子。
